highlights:
PROJECTS ON GITHUB:
https://github.com/fixture-candidate-02/flashdrive-watcher: Application runs on background and waiting for new USB-device. When it is connected application will synchronize specified directory on your HDD with current USB-device. GUI was created using WPF, database environment – using ADO.NET and LINQ, work with files – using TPL and Async model; 
https://github.com/fixture-candidate-02/base64-toolkit, https://github.com/fixture-candidate-02/huffman-archiver, https://github.com/fixture-candidate-02/cryptography-demo - Applications support encryption for files using different algorithms: XOR, RC4, Base64 and Huffmann’s algorithm.
https://github.com/fixture-candidate-02/cryptography-demo - Simplified TaskManager
